verified: edh-combat-7 (Commander lane edh-combat, tuning half), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the rulings (kw.line, trg.when, eff.edhcb7.youChooseBlocks; the battalion shape of the attacks event, count 4 or more): CR 509.1, 723.1, 508.1, 603.2c; rulings 2012-07-01: the controller chooses which creatures block and how, may decide a creature won't block, every declaration must still be legal and a cost to block is the blocker's controller's to pay (else a new set is proposed)

edh-combat-7 (Commander lane edh-combat, held-out, opened by the owner: commander request 2026-10-27), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the rulings (rst.edhcb7.cast.self.declareBlockersOpponentsTurn, eff.edhcb7.removeAttackersExtraCombat; the removeFromCombat binding): CR 601.3, 500.1, 506.4, 500.8, 508.1d, 508.1b, 506.3, 603.7a; rulings 2013-10-17: creatures that did not attack are not required to attack in the additional combat and may attack the caster; a creature that can't attack (tapped, summoning sick) doesn't, and costs to attack are not forced
